method: Same independent evaluator for every arm: exact best response of every seat after each checkpoint (mwcli --gain method=exact, separate process, deterministic). NashConv = sum of per-seat gains inside each abstraction (not exploitability). Paired per-seed ln(NashConv arm / NashConv default) at predefined training-time budgets and at checkpoint deal counts, log-log interpolation inside each arm's observed range; seeds outside either range are excluded (counted), never clamped. 95% t intervals; Holm over the primary comparisons.
